description: Fault tree for tritium discharge above the authorised limit (REQ-TRIT-014). Basic events and failure rates derive from the ADS FMEA.

elements.name: Tritium discharge to atmosphere exceeds authorised limit
elements.description: Top event. Challenges REQ-TRIT-014 (discharge within the authorised annual limit, reduced ALARP) and REQ-ADS-001 (decontamination factor >= 1000 at design-basis flow).

topEvent.name: Tritium discharge to atmosphere exceeds authorised limit

elements.name: Blower bearing seizure
elements.description: FMEA row 1. Lubrication loss; flow stops so no detritiation. Blower 12000 FIT x 50 % bearing seizure.

elements.name: Recombiner catalyst poisoning
elements.description: FMEA row 3. Siloxane/oil contamination; conversion drops so HT passes the beds unconverted. 2000 FIT x 60 %.

elements.name: Recombiner heater failure
elements.description: FMEA row 4. Element burnout; low bed temperature so low conversion. 2000 FIT x 40 %.

elements.name: Regeneration-path leak to stack
elements.description: FMEA row 6. Valve/gasket failure; HTO bypasses collection and reaches the stack directly, defeating the drying train entirely. Condenser 1500 FIT x 30 %.

elements.name: Dryer A sieve breakthrough
elements.description: FMEA row 7. Bed saturation; HTO passes the bed and stack release rises. Molecular-sieve bed 500 FIT x 70 %.

elements.name: Dryer B regeneration heater failure
elements.description: FMEA row 9. Element burnout; bed unavailable after regeneration so redundancy is lost. QUANTIFICATION DELIBERATELY UNSET: the FMEA component table gives no FIT figure for a regeneration heater, and an invented rate would be indistinguishable from a measured one. Unset is not zero -- this event is excluded from quantification until a rate is sourced.

elements.name: Changeover valves stuck mid-travel
elements.description: FMEA row 10. Actuator/stem seizure isolates BOTH beds, so this single failure defeats dual-bed redundancy on its own. Valve set 3000 FIT x 40 %. Proof tested six-monthly.

elements.name: Changeover valve seat leak-through
elements.description: FMEA row 11. Seat wear; partial bypass of the active bed reduces the decontamination factor. 3000 FIT x 60 %.

elements.name: Dewpoint monitor drift (reads dry)
elements.description: FMEA row 12. Sensor ageing. SHARED EVENT: this one failure defeats BOTH the mitigation and the detection. It suppresses the automatic dual-bed changeover that row 7 relies on as its safety mechanism, and it leaves breakthrough undetected. Hygrometer 4000 FIT x 50 %. Calibrated quarterly per REQ-ADS-011.

elements.name: Stack monitor loss of signal
elements.description: FMEA row 14. Detector/HV failure; the release goes unquantified and no independent alarm is raised. Ion chamber 3000 FIT x 100 %.

elements.name: Controller fails on power transition
elements.description: FMEA row 15. PSU/transition fault; no FailSafe entry during the outage. PLC 1000 FIT x 40 %, expressed per demand because the failure is on the transition, not over time.

elements.name: UPS battery degraded
elements.description: FMEA row 17. Ageing; restart exceeds 30 s on loss of off-site power, violating REQ-ADS-007. UPS 6000 FIT x 100 %. Periodic discharge test annually.

elements.name: Sustained undetected breakthrough
elements.description: Tritium reaches the stack un-detritiated AND the condition is not detected, so it persists rather than being isolated.

elements.name: Detritiation fails to remove tritium
elements.description: The ADS train does not remove tritiated species from the flow it receives.

elements.name: Loss of drying
elements.description: No molecular-sieve bed is removing HTO from the process flow.

elements.name: Both dryer beds unavailable
elements.description: Dual-bed redundancy exhausted: the duty bed is saturated, the standby bed cannot take over, and the changeover was never commanded.

elements.name: Upstream conversion loss
elements.description: The recombiner fails to convert HT to HTO. Elemental tritium is not captured by a molecular sieve, so it passes the beds regardless of their condition.

elements.name: Loss of motive flow
elements.description: Process gas is not being driven through the detritiation train.

elements.name: Loss of control on loss of off-site power
elements.description: On LOOP the controller does not reach its FailSafe state and the backup supply does not carry it. Challenges REQ-TRIT-030 and REQ-ADS-007.

elements.name: Release not detected
elements.description: Neither the dewpoint channel nor the stack channel raises the condition, so no isolation or operator action follows.

elements.name: TOP
elements.description: Either a direct bypass of the train, or a sustained breakthrough that nothing catches.

outputEvent.name: Tritium discharge to atmosphere exceeds authorised limit

elements.name: Breakthrough AND not detected
elements.description: Defence in depth: a challenge alone is not a release. It becomes one only when detection also fails, because a detected breakthrough triggers changeover or operator isolation.

elements.name: Any loss of removal
elements.description: Four independent ways the train stops removing tritium from the flow.

elements.name: Drying lost
elements.description: Either the valves isolate both beds outright, or both beds are individually unavailable.

elements.name: Both beds out AND no changeover
elements.description: The duty bed saturates, the standby bed is unavailable, and the dewpoint channel never commands the swap. All three are required: any one of them working preserves drying.

elements.name: Conversion lost
elements.description: Catalyst or heater. Either way HT is not converted and the sieve cannot capture it.

elements.name: Flow lost
elements.description: The blower itself, or the control and power that keep it running.

inputs.name: Loss of control on loss of off-site power

elements.name: Controller AND UPS fail
elements.description: The UPS exists to carry the controller through the transition, so both must fail before control is lost.

outputEvent.name: Loss of control on loss of off-site power

elements.name: Both detection channels fail
elements.description: Two independent channels: dewpoint at the bed outlet, activity at the stack. Both must fail for the release to go unnoticed -- which is why the dewpoint monitor appearing in G-04 as well matters so much.

elements.name: Condenser cooling water loss
elements.description: FMEA row 5. High moisture to the duty bed; rapid saturation and early breakthrough. Condenser 1500 FIT x 70 %. Modelled as a duty-bed cause; its common-cause effect on the standby bed after changeover is not modelled.

elements.name: Dryer A bed channelling
elements.description: FMEA row 8. Partial bypass of the sieve; premature partial breakthrough. Molecular-sieve bed 500 FIT x 30 %.

elements.name: Duty bed (dryer A) breakthrough
elements.description: The duty bed passes HTO: sieve saturation, channelling, or moisture overload from the condenser.

elements.name: Any duty-bed breakthrough cause
elements.description: Any one cause makes the duty bed break through.
